title: A Relation between Distance and Radial Velocity among Extra-Galactic Nebulae
lineage: Inspected provider-rendered passages or catalog as specified; local file is attributed research notes, not a copy of the source.

passages.note: NASA-hosted transcription of original article: PNAS 15, March 1929. 24 nebulae had individual distance estimates; two solutions used 24 individual objects or 9 groups. The text proposes K = 500 km/s per million parsecs as an illustrative rounded value.
